Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**THE RECORD BREAKER**

FADE IN:

INT. WORLD RECORD OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and camera crews. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is escorted to a podium, where a plaque awaits him.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, It Is Our Pleasure To Present The World Record For Oldest Human To Ever Live, Held By The Incomparable Jasper Jenkins!

Jasper's eyes light up as he accepts the plaque, a beaming smile spreading across his face.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jasper lies in bed, the plaque from earlier proudly displayed on his nightstand. He gazes at it, lost in thought. Suddenly, his eyes glaze over, and he begins to speak to himself in a hushed tone.

JASPER
(whispering)
Quantum Immortality... I Remember Reading About It In My Youth...

As he speaks, his voice grows louder, more urgent.

JASPER
(panicked)
It Said That If You Live Long Enough, You'll Eventually Experience Every Possible Branch Of Reality! That I'll Be Trapped In An Infinite Loop Of Parallel Universes, Forever Stuck In A Never-Ending Cycle Of Birth, Death, And Rebirth!

Jasper's eyes roll back in his head, and he begins to thrash about in bed.

JASPER
(screaming)
I'VE BEEN LIVING IN A PARALLEL UNIVERSE THE WHOLE TIME! EVERY DECISION I'VE EVER MADE, EVERY RELATIONSHIP I'VE EVER HAD, IT'S ALL BEEN A LIE! I'M JUST A SLAVE TO THE QUANTUM MACHINES THAT CONTROL THE FABRIC OF REALITY!

The camera zooms in on Jasper's face, his eyes wild with terror.

JASPER
(whispering)
I'M NOT JASPER JENKINS... I'M JUST A SIMULATION... A PROGRAM CREATED BY SOMEONE OR SOMETHING TO OBSERVE AND STUDY THE HUMAN EXPERIENCE...

Jasper's body begins to shake uncontrollably, his mind shattered by the weight of his own mortality.

CUT TO:

EXT. JASPER'S HOUSE - NIGHT

The camera pans across the quiet neighborhood, the stars twinkling above. The sound of Jasper's screams echoes through the night air, a haunting reminder of the fragility of the human mind.

FADE TO BLACK.

**THE END**
